summary:
# BOOK: The Cruise of the Gyro-Car (Herbert Strang, 1911; illus. A. C. Michael; publ. Henry Frowde/Hodder & Stoughton)

## Front matter
- Ads for Strang's other books: King of the Air (to Morocco by airship); Lord of the Seas (submarine); Swift and Sure (hydroplane); Jack Hardy (smuggling days). Price 2/6.
- Illustrations: frontispiece "The New and the Old" (p14); "A Desperate Expedient" (p73); "A Tense Moment" (p156); "The Rapids of the Black Drin" (p199); route map.
- Preface: Albania, Roman Via Egnatia; Scanderbeg held Turks ~25 yrs; Turks keep Albanians as "savage watchdog." Sources: J. G. von Hahn, Edward Lear, H. A. Brown, E. F. Knight, Miss M. E. Durham ("The Man and the Ass", "Dismembered Cow"). George Buckland = sole owner of gyro-car.

## Ch I Introduces the Gyro-Car
- Shepperton station, early summer evening. Maurice Buckland (tall, dark, "smart"; secretary, British agency Sofia; on short leave, first England visit in ~2 yrs) greeted by sister Sheila. Calls her "kid."
- Brother George (~18, from Winchester, to Cambridge in October, engineering) late.
- Aunt: Hon. Mrs. Courtenay-Greene, pince-nez, "looking down her nose," house The Acacias, Chertsey Road. Orphan niece/nephew.
- Accident at sharp curve, ~½ mile from station. Anchor Hotel, vicarage, old ivy church, post-office, Old King's Head opposite. Flyman swerves; gyro-car grazes fly's off hind wheel, hits brick wall. Car: four wheels tandem, gyroscopes; George: "adaptation of Louis Brennan's mono-rail car." Front wheel buckled.
- Maurice: "beautiful hole in the wall"; "manslaughter." Dinner: aunt wants to hear Tetrazzini. George sulks.
- Next day car to workshop at garden foot. Maurice sees car balancing unsupported; "Rummy! How's it done?" George: "Swank!"
- Gyroscope explained: "a top"; spins 5,000/min; vacuum. Car amphibious. Maurice: "I have made my will."

## Ch II Unwelcome Attentions
- Spin: Maurice "By George!" ×3. Foreigner at Weybridge Ferry corner.
- Yellow motor-car at Anchor. Foreigners: Count Slavianski (General; claims Russian/Polish) and secretary Major Rostopchin, plus servants.
- Train to Waterloo: Count speaks French about cricket; "Kent beat Yorkshire by three wickets." Maurice explains wickets. Count: "Les vainqueurs rossent les vaincus avec les stomps."
- Lock incident (river lock near Shepperton): Count praises gyro-car; gives card "General Count Slavianski"; invites to Anchor. Maurice refuses; George calls.
- Aunt refuses contact with foreigners.
- Three weeks later (a Monday): Foreign Office letter; 2.10 train; Foreign Secretary personally: despatch for Sofia chief; avoid Austrian/German soil; hints at Montenegrin minister searched in previous crisis. Plan: Brindisi, torpedo-boat, Constantinople, Sofia. Despatch ready next day; Paris train Charing Cross 2.20.
- Club: newspaper bill "BALKAN CRISIS." Background: Austria absorbed Bosnia-Herzegovina; Servian raids; 3 army corps mobilising; Belgrade, Cettinje threatened; Germany behind; Albania restive; Bulgaria courted; Russia, Turkey, Italy factors.
- 5 o'clock Waterloo train: Count and secretary enter compartment; Count: "A beautiful day." Off at Sunbury ("Bon soir, monsieur!"). Maurice finds bag swapped: contains only morning newspaper.
- Household: Sheila fond; George admires. Maurice: "world-forces."
- Night post-office trip; servant seen. Maurice suspects spying; tells George. George saw telegraph boy enter Anchor; Count left in motor for 4 o'clock train.
- Plan: Maurice leaves 10 o'clock without valise; George brings valise by gyro-car to Grand Hotel, Charing Cross, avoiding village.
- Midnight: brothers in overcoats/slippers exit via back door, hedge. Man smoking cigar in field opposite. "There's our proof."

## Ch III The Yellow Car
- Next morning: Maurice walks through village, past Count on hotel bench; train to Sunbury; Count and secretary board.
- Foreign Office, Under-Secretary: despatch delayed; new cipher. Mr. Rowlands sends Williams to inquire about Count. Maurice leaves bag with Under-Secretary.
- Writes dummy despatch, marked small mark, sealed in long envelope.
- Lost 2.20 Paris train (waited till 2.45). Secretary: "police report suspicious characters at termini." Admiralty launch arranged to Dover; slow train to Dover.
- Whitehall: men shadowing. Yellow car at Victoria Hotel, Northumberland Ave.
- Grand Hotel: George waiting. Craven Street back exit watched. Taxi zigzag plan; told driver "73, Cavendish Square"/"Thirty-seven."
- Yellow car at Trafalgar Sq (Hamburg-American Line). Haymarket: taxi chase lost (Coventry St, Windmill St, Brewer St, Golden Sq, Beak St, Regent St, Savile Row). Sovereign to driver.
- Driver to Strand, Arundel St, Temple, Embankment, De Keyser's Hotel: man telephones; taxi chases over bridge. Blackfriars, Elephant & Castle, Herne Hill.
- Gyro-car at Herne Hill, crowd cheers. Pursuer foreigner (not of Count's suite) on pavement.
- Left Herne Hill 3.45; Dover 6.20. Dover Road, Gravesend, Sittingbourne, Harbledown. Speed 35 mph; George wants 80.
- Idea: drive to Brindisi (not train). Maurice: Count will ride Paris train 9 o'clock.
- Admiralty launch; lieutenant; ten men lift car aboard. Telegram to aunt: George home "in a few days."
- Yellow car at Dover quay with policeman; Count checks; they drive off. Lieutenant curious.

## Ch IV Running the Plank
- Calais 8.15 (launch). Customs officer; Automobile Club card; no duty. Train 4.15 to Paris rejected.
- Night ride; half-moon; acetylene lamp; Béthune; octroi barriers; Porte Maillot (officer); Avenue Grande Armée, Champs Élysées, Place de l'Étoile.
- Taxi with two men near Porte Maillot. Hotel St. James (Rue St. Honoré), garage. 4.30 breakfast.
- George sees green racing motor (Count + Rostopchin), taxi, fiacre pass (2 men). Garçon: Calais train reaches Gare du Nord 4.15.
- Maurice: German spies; Count probably German ("Slavianski" false). Guide Taride ("Les Routes de France"). Route: Porte Daumesnil, Bois de Vincennes, Rue de Charenton, Charenton gate, Canal de Marne, Villeneuve-Saint-Georges, Melun.
- Melun hill: road broken; rope & lantern; small motor-car stops in gap; excavation; 16-ft plank. George steers onto plank; car across; wheels drop.
- Maurice: men helped chauffeur over wall; ambush. "We win the trick."

## Ch V Across the Alps
- Sivry; Montereau 7 am; blacksmith; gashed tyre; spare tyre. Speed limits discussed; "Mieux vaut prévenir que guérir."
- Sens (spare tyre, soup); Dijon ~12 (Place Darcy hotel, 7-franc déjeuner). Gendarme requests certificat de capacité; Maurice gives franc. Beaune 36 km.
- Maurice drives; George sleeps. Romenay: green motor behind. George drives 40 mph; Mantenay; St Julien geese; Javat 60 mph; Montrevel "Allure modérée"; Bourg; Ambérieu; Alberine valley; lake.
- Level crossings: Maurice's "German" bet story; keeper "Conspuez les Allemands!" Second crossing near Aix-les-Bains: keeper delays Germans.
- Chambéry octroi (bamboo stick). Modane 101 km; Customs: weighed as motor-cycle, 84 francs; no green light; Maurice's Austrian story. Italian limits: 40 km/h open, 12 town, 15 night.
- Turin 11 pm, Hotel Europa.

## Ch VI A Narrow Margin
- Count (real name Max Mumm) with secretary Ernst Böhmer (ex-cavalry sergeant, German).
- Le Viviers crossing: Count's licence "Alexis Slavianski, born Borisoglebsk"; keeper says "I know those Russians!"; Count bribe 5 francs refused.
- Modane: official delays; green light. Count reaches Modane ~2 hrs after.
- Gyro-car to Venice blind; turned south via Alessandria to Genoa (5 am). Hotel; route via Pisa, Leghorn, Rome, Naples.
- Genoa coast road; skid in greasy mud near bend; steered past stone post; brambles. Maurice: "excoriating."
- Pisa, Arno, Leghorn, Volterra, Colle, Siena; tyre burst near village; luncheon hard bread & eggs.
- Rome 4 pm (British Stores: petrol, two tyres). Naples (~midnight). Left 2 am; Eboli; Sele river; dawn.
- Race: green car; Potenza; Ginosa; 17 switchbacks in 10 miles. Power failure near Ginosa.

## Ch VII An Act of War
- Lane; carburettor nozzle foul. Count fires at them; George away ("Won by a neck!"). Maurice: "a head with brains."
- Castellane; Mottola; Taranto; Francavilla; Brindisi 11.20 (mail due 11.30). Virgil's death place; column of Appian Way.
- English naval officer (torpedo-boat aground in mist; Malta wire). Maurice: "My name is Buckland."
- Hotel lunch. Ideas: cross Strait of Otranto by gyro; Albania route.
- Margherita (trading vessel, skipper Antonio Fagazzi of Gallipoli; Durazzo/Hagio Saranda). Five English sovereigns. Plan: petrol tins loaded; gyro to Villanuova at dusk, towed across.
- Telegram via postal official: "Nobleman notorious foreign spy: be on guard." No Albania maps in town.

## Ch VIII A Roman Road
- Dined with officer. Left ~5 pm; S. Vito de Normanni; Ostuni; Villanuova (~20 min from Brindisi). Green car overshoots; turns back.
- Gyro into sea; Austrian gunboat passes; Margherita sighted at night; lamp signals; Fagazzi hauls courses; towed.
- Dawn Durazzo (Dyrhacchium; Cicero's exile). Customs: "boat or motor-car?"; duties paid; passport; George = "chauffeur."
- Durazzo hotel-keeper: Austrian influence among Albanians. Launch approaching (Austrian-looking). Buy fezzes.
- Bimbashi of Turkish garrison; questions. Road to Tirana: rough; ford river 8 times; stone bridge; turkeys; Tirana filthy; grapes.
- Mountains; horsemen behind (Slavianski with guides). Elbasan white minarets.

## Ch IX The Honour of an Albanian
- Elbasan gate; narrow street; Skumbi bridge; clay cliffs.
- Young man with rifle (Giorgio). Shot from hill (Leka, owner of house opposite; blood feud over haystacks). Maurice helps Giorgio into car.
- "For blood, excellence." House of family: grandfather Giulika; sons Dushmani; grandsons Marko, Doda; cousin; kula (3-storey watchtower). "We have guests" warning; besa.
- Egg-and-salt dressing; rakia; kid meal. Giorgio's history: accused, acquitted; now feud.
- Swordsmith of Elbasan (Moslem) demands guests; Giulika refuses: "my honour."
- Advice: via Prizren/north (safer); or Black Drin by river (gyro as boat). Old man knows mountain path.
- Attack: battering ram; brothers fire; Leka's men fire from opposite house; attackers retreat; Slavianski seen.

## Ch X Some Riddles and a Nursery Rhyme
- Barricade; supper; millstone removed; enemy camp; Scanderbeg songs.
- Riddles: snail ("Though not an ox… horns… silver"); candle ("wool inside, flesh outside"); donkey story (two thieves; magician); cow-in-pieces story (Giorgio).
- Dawn attack: tree-trunk ram; door broken; ladder withdrawn; fire set to stores.
- George: car will explode. Maurice surrenders: "Count Slavianski, spare the household."
- Disarmed; Count with despatch in long envelope; cipher key ("little book"). Rostopchin confirms.
- Deciphered text nonsense: "Hey, diddle, diddle, / Ze cat and ze fiddle, / Ze cow jomp over ze moon." Maurice explains idiomatically; Count fumes: "ten minutes… If you do not, you shall be shot."

## Ch XI In the Small Hours
- Maurice searched; car searched; Guide Taride, maps, provisions found. Ultimatum to George: "Are you a fool like your brozer?"
- Maurice's cigarette snatched; tied; Count orders Elbasan man to shoot. Man refuses ("I have killed five men for blood… not shoot a man like a dog").
- Count aims revolver. Maurice: "My Government has a long arm." Rostopchin persuades.
- Prisoners left on guard; starved; no drink. Guard dozes; Giorgio slips through window, kills guard, cuts bonds.
- Car wheeled out (George, Marko). Giulika: "Is it worth a life?" Gourd of sour milk. "Only one man is dead." Giulika: "our honour is clean."
- Path to Black Drin; lamp; time ~1 am.

## Ch XII The Swamp
- Steep path; George starts gyroscope motor for haulage; Albanians amazed.
- Zutni (friend) house; Leka and Giorgio share mug (besa). Sleep. Morning coffee.
- Ruined village (burned by Turks). Swamp; planks from burned barn; plank pier; car crosses.
- Horsemen fire; Giorgio's arm wounded; Leka: "I would sooner drown myself."
- Slavianski tests swamp; horse sinks; they circle around.

## Ch XIII A Landslip in the Hills
- Eastern rise; engine restarted. Giulika refuses ride: "nothing but a horse."
- Landslide blocks path; Giulika: "God's will." Plan: Zutni and marksmen hold bend; others cut way through.
- Rifle barrel/arm shot; rifle drawn back. Eagle. Count's shouts; "You are our leader, excellence." Men reluctant.
- Path cleared; Giulika sends Maurice & George with Giorgio in car. Shouts from heights.
- Petrol plug falls out; trail; Maurice finds plug by "instinct from golf balls."
- "Is that the Drin?" "We have won the race."

## Ch XIV A Rush Through the Rapids
- Black Drin yellowish-brown; gorge; car floated into river (Giorgio alarmed).
- Trebischte bridge (one-arch, high). Rapids beyond; no one has run them.
- Men on bridge with stones; Maurice fires rifle; George swerves; men duck; boat passes under.
- Ambush on both banks; rifles; boulder gashes hull; rock hits Giorgio's head; gyroscope glass case shattered.
- Maurice shot above right knee; hides pain.
- Giulika and party on left bank fire in air; Giorgio: "We are saved!"
- Zutni: bridge 3 hrs down-river. Plan: Prizren via White Drin confluence.
- Giorgio leaves at bridge; Giulika's party meets them. Feast promised. Maurice settles tip discreetly later.

## Ch XV The End of the Cruise
- Cove for night; Black/White Drin junction ~3 pm; bridge; kula; man with rifle gives bread; Prizren 4 hrs.
- Prizren: bazaars; han; hanji; wine-measure washing.
- Zaptiehs officer; teskereh "not in order"; Chief of Police; Austrian vice-consul avoided. Chief asks capital of England: "London."
- Morning washing from balcony. Seralio: Pasha (tall, medals); pink syrup; wound seen by hakim; race proposed (horseman vs gyro, valley course).
- George's idea (smoke trick). Night visit by Pasha; race terms: ~40 miles to railway and back; 10 o'clock.
- Race: horseman, 100-yard start; Morava river; Mitrovitza; main line; smoke frightens horse; gyro passes railway; Sofia ~5 pm; agent's office.
- Despatch found hidden in engine bonnet; handed to chief.

## Ch XVI Reconciliation and Rewards
- Foreign Secretary telegram; troops disbanded; editor's request refused.
- George at Sofia; King gives cigarette; Mrs. Courtenay-Greene's letter; George goes to Constantinople by train (car by truck), home by steamer.
- Christmas: Maurice's fortnight; George joins; Trieste → Scutari → Giulika's district.
- Brigands attacking European (Slavianski: thigh broken by fall, healed by bone-setter from Trebischte; leg shorter). Black cock breastbone omen. Slavianski ambushed.
- Giulika: "honour." Maurice persuades Giulika to accept money to rebuild kula; Slavianski spared.
- Blood-gelt ~£25; Maurice pays Leka; Leka & Giorgio kiss; Leka buys new rifle.
- Christmas church; rifle shooting; besa week.
- Parted at Scutari; Slavianski lame, sent away.
- Years later Vienna: Maurice meets the lame ex-Count (saluted) at a club: "I met him… in a gyro-car."

THE END.
